name: split-attn
hypothesis: Profile (fused-layer, 4,096-token prompt): attention is 10.8 of ~15 ms per decode token, because each head's 8-SIMD online softmax walks 512 positions serially at ~3.5 us a step. Split it: a parallel launch computes every position's q.k with mk_attention's lane ownership, fma order and simd_sum; the chain then reproduces each SIMD's recurrence over the stored scores in the same order, with the prefix max, f and es computed 32 steps at a time (max is exact in any association) and value loads pipelined. Plus one launch for q/k norms, ropes and K/V stores (-5 dispatches per attention layer) and a two-stage argmax. Expect decode at 4,096 to rise from ~65 to above 200 tok/s, at 1,024 from ~128 to ~230, and ~+15% at 64.
